question: Should the dashboard-design workflow be a ClawHub skill that consumes a dashboard/preview screenshot API, or an official bundled dashboard feature?
rationale: VISION.md prefers new skills through ClawHub, but this request also depends on a security-sensitive dashboard screenshot capability that likely needs dashboard or preview-plugin ownership before a skill can safely consume it.

options.title: ClawHub Skill After API
options.body: Keep core/plugin work limited to the screenshot/inspection API and publish the workflow as a ClawHub skill once that API is stable.

options.title: Bundle With Dashboard
options.body: Sponsor the skill as official bundled dashboard behavior and require explicit product ownership plus security proof before implementation.

options.title: Defer Until Prerequisites Land
options.body: Leave this parked until the modular-dashboard stack and preview-widget inspection direction are settled.

recommendation.title: ClawHub Skill After API
recommendation.body: Keep core/plugin work limited to the screenshot/inspection API and publish the workflow as a ClawHub skill once that API is stable.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest current-main history for the plugin-tab/dashboard seam that this roadmap builds on.
